description:
## Goal

After fz-kdt.4 replaces RuntimeDemand cone replay, prove the final epic head restores or improves the range-map deterministic compiler-work budget. A generous wall-clock nontermination guard may land independently through fz-kdt.175; it is not performance evidence and does not waive this ticket.

## Recorded transition signal

Under one GitHub llvm-cov job, the range-map run interval was approximately 1.47s on main, 3.02s after fz-kdt.47, 2.95s after fz-tfn.3, 3.02s after fz-kdt.72, 3.02s after fz-tfn.17, and 2.25s after fz-kdt.45. Wall clock identified the regression but is contention-sensitive.

Deterministic range-map evidence is authoritative:

- main: 918 scheduler jobs, 3,837 product settlements, 0 CallableResolution jobs, and cone work 13 settlements / 623 member visits / 151 rounds / 2,971 derivations;
- current direct-fact transition: 1,083 scheduler jobs, 3,798 product settlements, 84 CallableResolution jobs, and cone work 18 / 898 / 216 / 4,276;
- backend/native output remains identical: 59 executables, 193 bodies, and 95,220 code bytes.

The temporary callable-resolution barrier plus retained cone repartition/replay explains the extra work. Do not optimize the temporary cone in isolation; fz-kdt.4 must delete that model.

## Strategy and TDD

1. Land only after fz-kdt.4 removes whole-cone settlement/retry/publication.
2. Count per-executable RuntimeDemand formula evaluations and exact causing movements for range-map, 00420, and predicate fixtures.
3. Add deterministic work ratchets against the recorded pre-cutover baselines; pin the post-cutover counts only after proving strict improvement.
4. Require zero cone/replay symbols and telemetry, zero readiness-caused RuntimeDemand evaluations, and zero unattributed evaluations.
5. Prove live backend/native executable and body contracts, required canonical artifacts, diagnostics and stdout parity. Apply the user's approved removal rule: cross-version inventory/byte differences are allowed only for proven-unused removal or causally demonstrated less work, with every difference attributed. Same-version unchanged artifacts and reuse remain exact.
6. Record a release-mode distribution only as corroborating evidence, never as a test threshold.
7. Remove temporary comparison counters, switches, captures, and migration fixtures before review. Reuse retained causal/corpus observations rather than adding duplicate compilation loops.
8. Run all target doors, full library, serial matrix, fz2_cli, cross-process determinism, formatting, and strict clippy.

## Acceptance

- RuntimeDemand deterministic work is strictly better than the recorded mainline cone derivation baselines for range-map, 00420, and predicate fixtures.
- No cone collection, round, retry, snapshot replay, whole-cone publication, or associated telemetry remains.
- Readiness movement causes no RuntimeDemand formula evaluation and every non-initial evaluation names changed content.
- Semantic product answers, live backend/native contracts, required artifacts, diagnostics and runtime outputs retain full fidelity. Same-version unchanged artifacts/reuse are exact. Approved cross-version removals of proven-unused work are explicitly attributed, not restored merely to match obsolete counts.
- The fixture timeout is documented only as a nontermination guard; no wall-clock performance threshold is introduced.
- The epic cannot complete while this ticket is open.

## Current predecessor guideposts

The remaining harness dependency is fz-tfn.29; .28 closed with deterministic readiness classification and two green534-test parallel matrices. .27 closed in534570e5a with53 fewer native helpers and6360 fewer native bytes across475 resolved corpus fixtures, preserving all live artifacts/contracts; .18 closed in537280e35 with exact root contributions. These approved removals must not be undone to recreate the older construction inventories. .27 measurement is .agent/measurements/fz-tfn.27-native-helper-emission.md. Root retains final representative range/predicate/take-drop artifacts and telemetry at /tmp/fz-tfn27-after.2d8YSN (binaryb2afe0282049713256436d324d6242f989c4ebf83435aa2243fb1413b11da772) and pre-.27 at /tmp/fz-tfn18-final.YsnYkB. These locate current evidence; establish exact RuntimeDemand causal count correspondence to the recorded cone baselines before ratcheting. No .24 acceptance is claimed yet.

## Measurement due diligence

Source inspection at534570e5a: derive_runtime_demand_fact calls derive_executable_runtime_demand inside a local loop (jobs/runtime_demand.rs164-214). Discovering settled first-class construction targets or additional target input demands grows the local snapshot and repeats that derivation; construction_targets starts empty (RuntimeDemandFormulaSnapshot::new). Existing work_graph.applied counters count scheduler completions, while FORMULA_CAPTURE retains one final answer per member. Neither alone proves the number of body derivations comparable to the old cone-member derivation baseline. Before asserting strict work improvement, measure the actual derivation boundary and attribute local repetitions, distinguish prerequisite-wait returns from derivations, and decide from evidence whether any redundant work can be removed. Reuse or replace instrumentation rather than retaining misleading duplicate counters; no new performance regression is claimed solely from this source-level lead.


## Active implementation evidence

Implementation started at 4fc5616d8 after .29 closed. The first measurement extends the existing JobEffects / JobCompletion / public causal report with the actual RuntimeDemand body-derivation count, incremented at derive_executable_runtime_demand. Prerequisite waits count zero; repeated local walks count individually. The counter is state, not part of causal formula identity.

The existing three-fixture/five-request regression uses augmented sources with reached/unreachable leaf edits. Before optimization its cold body walks are 246 / 632 / 1451 for range / predicate / 00420, versus scheduler completions 283 / 694 / 1290. These augmented-source figures are not substituted for exact historical fixture comparisons. RED /tmp/fz-tfn24-red.log (handle 2205, exit 101) proves a strictly-lower-work assertion fails before change. The candidate deletes the premature continue after loading construction targets, incorporating their available input vectors in the same snapshot update before any repeated walk. First optimized measurement remains in progress at /tmp/fz-tfn24-green-work.log, handle 52143.

Historical baseline provenance: exact main a3a9761d1209165e5230625b9347cf6b0ad09b83 predicate interp, documented in fz-f98.23, has 6378 derivations and 1441 jobs across three equal runs. Raw /tmp/fz-f98.23-enum-predicate.71630.jsonl SHA256 ee72eea45123a5d2aa884e397a526c1e7a782917c96b925f1ede4743d6aec072 confirms 10 cone events totaling 6378. The old derive counter increments directly before derive_member_demand. Main 00420 raw /tmp/fz-kdt5-cold-00420-a3a9761d.jsonl SHA256 50fdfeb20ccd7e97981f46dd6158a8f9c73953a99a8a49fcd82714f7f8eb001d has 8 events [2,2,1028,1028,1028,1028,1068,1068] totaling 6252; the earlier 6250 documentation was arithmetic error, not a different metric. Range ticket baseline 2971 uses native/run whereas an old interp trace totals 2401; preserve the command distinction.

No acceptance is claimed yet. Still required: final exact original-fixture counts and causal/artifact correspondence, deterministic ratchets, release distribution, all target doors and full verification, removal of temporary print output, updated documentation, and fresh scoped cold review.
title: Restore range-map work budget after RuntimeDemand cutover
